adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines two computed object keys as `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. `z.string()` returns a Zod schema object, so `.toString()` will not produce a dynamic key matcher; it will produce a literal string key (likely `"[object Object]"`). The second computed key also overwrites the first, so the schema effectively only has `access_token` plus one literal property, and Zod will strip all other fields by default—meaning expiry fields (and other token fields) will be dropped from `refreshTokenResponse.data` when this minimum schema path is used.
